# load data in 'global' chunk so it can be shared by all users of the dashboard

library(shinyauthr)
library(shinyBS)
library(plotly)

library(png)
library(grid)
library(RSQLite)
library(shinydashboard)
library(glue)
library(readr)
# NOTE: imputeTS was a leftover import from the old Stineman-interpolation
# preprocessing pipeline (see README) and is not called anywhere in this
# file or in util.R (which does its own gap-aware cleaning). Dropped so
# the app does not require an extra, unused dependency to start.
tryCatch({
  source("util.R")
  sql_db_file <<- "exoplanet_db.sqlite"
  processed <<- list.files("trained_models/", full.names = F)
  all_stars <<- list.files("data/", pattern = ".tbl", full.names = F)
  data_dir <<- "data/"
  plots_dir <<- "plots/test_pred_plot/"
}, error = function(e) {
  source("../util.R")
  sql_db_file <<- "../exoplanet_db.sqlite"
  processed <<- list.files("../trained_models/", full.names = F)
  all_stars <<- list.files("../data/", pattern = ".tbl", full.names = F)
  data_dir <<- "../data/"
  plots_dir <<- "../plots/test_pred_plot/"
})

return_stars <- function(processed) {
  processed <- strsplit(processed, "_")
  processed <- unique(sapply(processed, function(filename) filename[1]))
  return(processed)
}

# Converts a {starts, ends} list (as returned by get_candidate_indices) into
# a list of c(start, end) windows, dropping the (0, 0) placeholder row used
# to mark "no tags yet".
indices_to_windows <- function(idx) {
  if (is.null(idx) || length(idx$starts) == 0) return(list())
  keep <- which(idx$starts > 0 & idx$ends >= idx$starts)
  if (length(keep) == 0) return(list())
  lapply(keep, function(k) c(idx$starts[k], idx$ends[k]))
}

# Builds the interactive light-curve plot.
#   mode = "view" -> read-only, points colored red/black by idx_mask (the
#                     usual model-detection / saved-tag overlay)
#   mode = "tag"  -> manual tagging session: draws each window in
#                     tag_windows_list as a translucent, EDITABLE rectangle
#                     that the user can drag on either edge to resize, or
#                     drag the body to move. New windows are defined by
#                     drag-selecting empty plot area (dragmode = "select"),
#                     which is a distinct gesture from editing an existing
#                     shape, so both work on the same plot at once.
build_light_curve_plotly <- function(test_vec, pred_vec, xlim, ylim, idx_mask,
                                      title_str, mode = c("view", "tag"),
                                      tag_windows_list = NULL, source_id = "trainPlot_src") {
  mode <- match.arg(mode)
  n <- length(test_vec)
  x_idx <- seq_len(n)
  marker_color <- if (mode == "tag") rep("black", n) else ifelse(idx_mask, "red", "black")

  p <- plot_ly(source = source_id) %>%
    add_markers(x = x_idx, y = test_vec,
                marker = list(color = marker_color, size = 4),
                name = "Light Curve", hoverinfo = "x+y")

  if (length(pred_vec) == n) {
    p <- p %>% add_lines(x = x_idx, y = pred_vec,
                          line = list(color = "dodgerblue", width = 1.5),
                          name = "Autoencoder Baseline")
  }

  shapes_list <- list()
  if (mode == "tag" && length(tag_windows_list) > 0) {
    for (w in tag_windows_list) {
      shapes_list[[length(shapes_list) + 1]] <- list(
        type = "rect", xref = "x", yref = "paper",
        x0 = w[1], x1 = w[2], y0 = 0, y1 = 1,
        fillcolor = "rgba(255,165,0,0.28)",
        line = list(color = "rgba(217,119,6,0.95)", width = 2),
        editable = TRUE
      )
    }
  }

  p <- p %>%
    layout(title = title_str,
           xaxis = list(title = "Cadence Index", range = xlim),
           yaxis = list(title = "Normalized Flux", range = ylim),
           dragmode = "select",
           shapes = shapes_list,
           legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.15)) %>%
    config(displaylogo = FALSE,
           editable = (mode == "tag"),
           edits = list(shapePosition = (mode == "tag")))

  return(p)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# BLS (Box Least Squares) period verification
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# A self-contained, heuristic BLS-style search used only by the dashboard
# to sanity-check the period/duration/depth implied by a star's currently
# tagged (or model-detected) transit windows against the full light curve.
# This is NOT the training pipeline's detection step - it is read-only and
# purely for on-screen verification.
#
#   flux         - numeric vector of (cleaned) flux values, one per cadence
#   windows      - list of c(start, end) cadence-index pairs for the
#                  currently tagged/detected windows; used only to seed a
#                  sensible transit-duration search range
#   cadence_days - days per cadence (Kepler long cadence ~29.4 min)
#   n_periods    - number of trial periods to scan
#   n_bins       - number of phase bins used for folding
#
# Returns NULL if there isn't enough usable data, otherwise a list with
# period_days, duration_days, depth, depth_pct, snr, folded_phase,
# folded_flux and transit_phase_range (for the verification plot).
run_bls_search <- function(flux, windows, cadence_days = 29.4 / 1440,
                            n_periods = 200, n_bins = 80) {
  n <- length(flux)
  ok <- is.finite(flux)
  if (sum(ok) < 20) return(NULL)

  idx <- which(ok)
  fl <- flux[ok]
  baseline <- stats::median(fl)
  resid <- baseline - fl  # positive during a transit dip, whatever the flux baseline is

  # Duration hint (in cadences) from currently tagged/detected windows
  win_lens <- if (length(windows) > 0) sapply(windows, function(w) diff(w) + 1) else numeric(0)
  dur_guess <- if (length(win_lens) > 0) stats::median(win_lens) else max(3, round(0.02 * n))
  dur_candidates <- unique(pmax(2, round(dur_guess * c(0.5, 0.75, 1, 1.5, 2))))

  min_period <- max(dur_candidates) * 3
  max_period <- floor(n / 2)
  if (!is.finite(min_period) || max_period <= min_period) return(NULL)
  period_grid <- unique(round(seq(min_period, max_period, length.out = n_periods)))

  # Sum of v over a circular window of length k starting at every position
  circular_rolling_sum <- function(v, k) {
    m <- length(v)
    ext <- c(v, v[seq_len(k)])
    csum <- c(0, cumsum(ext))
    csum[(k + 1):(m + k)] - csum[1:m]
  }

  best <- list(sr = -Inf)
  for (P in period_grid) {
    phase <- ((idx - 1) %% P) / P
    bin <- pmin(n_bins, floor(phase * n_bins) + 1)

    y <- numeric(n_bins); cnt <- numeric(n_bins)
    agg_sum <- tapply(resid, bin, sum)
    agg_cnt <- tapply(resid, bin, length)
    y[as.integer(names(agg_sum))] <- agg_sum
    cnt[as.integer(names(agg_cnt))] <- agg_cnt
    if (sum(cnt) == 0) next
    w <- cnt / sum(cnt)

    d_bins_set <- unique(pmax(1, pmin(n_bins - 1, round(n_bins * dur_candidates / P))))
    for (d_bins in d_bins_set) {
      roll_y <- circular_rolling_sum(y, d_bins)
      roll_w <- circular_rolling_sum(w, d_bins)
      sr <- (roll_y ^ 2) / (roll_w * (1 - roll_w) + 1e-9)
      j <- which.max(sr)
      if (isTRUE(sr[j] > best$sr) && roll_w[j] > 0) {
        best <- list(sr = sr[j], period = P, d_bins = d_bins, phase_bin = j,
                     w_in = roll_w[j], y_in = roll_y[j])
      }
    }
  }

  if (!is.finite(best$sr) || best$sr <= 0 || is.null(best$period)) return(NULL)

  period_days <- best$period * cadence_days
  duration_days <- (best$d_bins / n_bins) * period_days
  depth <- best$y_in / (best$w_in * length(idx))  # mean in-transit residual, flux units
  depth_pct <- if (abs(baseline) > 1e-9) 100 * depth / abs(baseline) else NA

  raw_phase <- ((idx - 1) %% best$period) / best$period
  transit_center <- ((best$phase_bin - 1) + best$d_bins / 2) / n_bins
  shifted_phase <- (raw_phase - transit_center + 0.5) %% 1  # re-center transit at phase 0.5
  half_dur_frac <- (best$d_bins / n_bins) / 2

  list(
    period_days = period_days,
    duration_days = duration_days,
    depth = depth,
    depth_pct = depth_pct,
    snr = sqrt(max(best$sr, 0)),
    folded_phase = shifted_phase,
    folded_flux = fl,
    transit_phase_range = c(0.5 - half_dur_frac, 0.5 + half_dur_frac)
  )
}

# Phase-folded verification plot for a run_bls_search() result: flux vs.
# orbital phase (duplicated at phase+1 for visual continuity), with the
# detected in-transit phase range shaded.
build_phase_fold_plotly <- function(res) {
  x <- c(res$folded_phase, res$folded_phase + 1)
  y <- c(res$folded_flux, res$folded_flux)
  rng <- res$transit_phase_range

  p <- plot_ly() %>%
    add_markers(x = x, y = y,
                marker = list(color = "black", size = 4, opacity = 0.5),
                name = "Folded Flux", hoverinfo = "x+y") %>%
    layout(
      title = sprintf("Phase-Folded Light Curve (P = %.3f days)", res$period_days),
      xaxis = list(title = "Orbital Phase", range = c(0, 1.3)),
      yaxis = list(title = "Flux"),
      shapes = list(
        list(type = "rect", xref = "x", yref = "paper",
             x0 = rng[1], x1 = rng[2], y0 = 0, y1 = 1,
             fillcolor = "rgba(220,38,38,0.15)",
             line = list(color = "rgba(220,38,38,0.6)", width = 1)),
        list(type = "rect", xref = "x", yref = "paper",
             x0 = rng[1] + 1, x1 = rng[2] + 1, y0 = 0, y1 = 1,
             fillcolor = "rgba(220,38,38,0.15)",
             line = list(color = "rgba(220,38,38,0.6)", width = 1))
      ),
      showlegend = FALSE
    ) %>%
    config(displaylogo = FALSE)

  return(p)
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Bandit-style star selector (Thompson Sampling over tagging agreement)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Goal: given the user_star (per-user tags) and test_idx (model-detected
# candidates) tables already queried elsewhere in this file, recommend
# which star most needs another set of eyes on it - i.e. stars that are
# under-tagged (few/no users have looked at them) or where taggers
# disagree with each other.
#
# Why Thompson Sampling rather than a plain epsilon-greedy or UCB1 rule:
#   - Epsilon-greedy explores uniformly at random a fixed fraction of the
#     time, regardless of how much evidence already exists for a star. It
#     can't tell "nobody has tagged this yet" apart from "everybody
#     agrees on this", so it wastes exploration on already-settled stars.
#   - UCB1 is deterministic given the current table state: every session
#     that asks "what should I tag next?" gets back the exact same star.
#     This dashboard is a live, multi-user Shiny app - several people can
#     hit the selector within the same minute - so a deterministic rule
#     would pile everyone onto one star while the rest of the backlog
#     goes untouched.
#   - Thompson Sampling instead treats each star as a Beta-Bernoulli arm
#     and draws a fresh random sample from its posterior every time a
#     recommendation is requested. That randomness spreads concurrent
#     users across several high-priority stars instead of colliding on
#     one, while still concentrating probability mass on stars that most
#     need attention - and it does so without a hand-tuned exploration
#     rate, since "no data yet" already IS maximum uncertainty under a
#     Beta(1, 1) prior.
#
# Arm / reward definition: pulling a star's arm = showing it to a tagger;
# "reward" = 1 if that tagger's windows would disagree with the existing
# consensus, 0 if they'd agree. We don't have that outcome ahead of time,
# so instead of waiting on a live feedback loop we approximate the
# posterior directly, live, from the tags already on file:
#   - >= 2 human taggers: reward posterior is built from the mean
#     pairwise agreement (IoU) across every pair of taggers' saved
#     windows, weighted by how many pairs that mean is based on.
#   - exactly 1 human tagger: compared against the model's own
#     test_idx detection as a (weaker) second opinion.
#   - 0 human taggers: no evidence at all -> uniform Beta(1, 1), i.e.
#     maximum uncertainty, which is exactly what should invite a look.

# Merges a list of c(start, end) windows into a minimal sorted, non
# overlapping set (adjacent/overlapping windows combined).
merge_windows <- function(windows) {
  if (length(windows) == 0) return(list())
  mat <- do.call(rbind, windows)
  mat <- mat[order(mat[, 1]), , drop = FALSE]
  merged <- list(as.numeric(mat[1, ]))
  if (nrow(mat) > 1) {
    for (i in 2:nrow(mat)) {
      last <- merged[[length(merged)]]
      if (mat[i, 1] <= last[2] + 1) {
        merged[[length(merged)]][2] <- max(last[2], mat[i, 2])
      } else {
        merged[[length(merged) + 1]] <- as.numeric(mat[i, ])
      }
    }
  }
  merged
}

# Total number of cadence indices covered by a (merged) window set
windows_length <- function(windows) {
  if (length(windows) == 0) return(0)
  sum(vapply(windows, function(w) w[2] - w[1] + 1, numeric(1)))
}

# Total overlap length between two (merged) window sets
windows_intersection_length <- function(a, b) {
  if (length(a) == 0 || length(b) == 0) return(0)
  total <- 0
  for (wa in a) {
    for (wb in b) {
      lo <- max(wa[1], wb[1]); hi <- min(wa[2], wb[2])
      if (hi >= lo) total <- total + (hi - lo + 1)
    }
  }
  total
}

# Jaccard/IoU agreement between two taggers' window sets, in [0, 1].
# Two taggers who both explicitly found nothing (both empty) are defined
# to fully agree; one empty and one non-empty fully disagree.
windows_iou <- function(windows_a, windows_b) {
  a <- merge_windows(windows_a)
  b <- merge_windows(windows_b)
  len_a <- windows_length(a); len_b <- windows_length(b)
  if (len_a == 0 && len_b == 0) return(1)
  inter <- windows_intersection_length(a, b)
  union_len <- len_a + len_b - inter
  if (union_len <= 0) return(1)
  inter / union_len
}

# All human-tagged window sets for a star, one entry per user_id, using
# the same (0,0)-placeholder-drops-to-empty-set convention as
# indices_to_windows() elsewhere in this file.
get_star_human_tag_sets <- function(db_conn, kepler_id) {
  rows <- dbGetQuery(db_conn, "SELECT user_id, start, end FROM user_star WHERE kepler_id = ?;",
                      params = list(kepler_id))
  if (nrow(rows) == 0) return(list())
  by_user <- split(rows, rows$user_id)
  lapply(by_user, function(df) indices_to_windows(list(starts = df$start, ends = df$end)))
}

# The model's own detected windows for a star (test_idx), or NULL if the
# table doesn't exist yet or has no rows for this star.
get_star_model_tag_set <- function(db_conn, kepler_id) {
  if (!dbExistsTable(db_conn, "test_idx")) return(NULL)
  rows <- dbGetQuery(db_conn, "SELECT start, end FROM test_idx WHERE id = ?;",
                      params = list(kepler_id))
  if (nrow(rows) == 0) return(NULL)
  indices_to_windows(list(starts = rows$start, ends = rows$end))
}

# Live Beta-Bernoulli pseudo-counts for one star's "needs more tagging"
# arm, derived from whatever tags currently exist for it.
compute_star_bandit_stats <- function(db_conn, kepler_id) {
  human_sets <- get_star_human_tag_sets(db_conn, kepler_id)
  n_human <- length(human_sets)

  if (n_human >= 2) {
    pairs <- utils::combn(seq_len(n_human), 2, simplify = FALSE)
    ious <- vapply(pairs, function(p) windows_iou(human_sets[[p[1]]], human_sets[[p[2]]]), numeric(1))
    mean_agree <- mean(ious)
    n_pairs <- length(ious)
    tag_source <- "human-human"
  } else if (n_human == 1) {
    model_set <- get_star_model_tag_set(db_conn, kepler_id)
    if (!is.null(model_set)) {
      mean_agree <- windows_iou(human_sets[[1]], model_set)
      n_pairs <- 0.5  # model-vs-human is a weaker signal than human-vs-human
      tag_source <- "human-model"
    } else {
      mean_agree <- 0.5
      n_pairs <- 0
      tag_source <- "single-tagger"
    }
  } else {
    mean_agree <- 0.5
    n_pairs <- 0
    tag_source <- "cold-start"
  }

  list(n_human = n_human, mean_agree = mean_agree, n_pairs = n_pairs, source = tag_source,
       alpha_disagree = 1 + n_pairs * (1 - mean_agree),  # Beta "successes" = disagreement
       alpha_agree = 1 + n_pairs * mean_agree)            # Beta "failures" = agreement
}

# One Thompson-Sampling draw from a star's posterior "needs more tagging"
# probability. Called fresh (new random draw) every time a pick is made.
sample_star_priority <- function(star_stats) {
  stats::rbeta(1, star_stats$alpha_disagree, star_stats$alpha_agree)
}

# Ranks every star in `star_options` (dropdown-format strings, e.g.
# "kplr001718189") by a fresh Thompson-Sampling draw. Returns a data
# frame sorted with the recommended star first.
rank_stars_by_bandit <- function(db_conn, star_options) {
  ids <- vapply(star_options, function(s) as.integer(gsub("^kplr", "", strsplit(s, "_")[[1]][1])), integer(1))
  stats_list <- lapply(ids, function(id) compute_star_bandit_stats(db_conn, id))
  samples <- vapply(stats_list, sample_star_priority, numeric(1))
  out <- data.frame(
    star = star_options,
    kepler_id = ids,
    n_human = vapply(stats_list, `[[`, integer(1), "n_human"),
    mean_agree = vapply(stats_list, `[[`, numeric(1), "mean_agree"),
    source = vapply(stats_list, `[[`, character(1), "source"),
    priority_sample = samples,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  out[order(-out$priority_sample), ]
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Community Tags view helper
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Clusters every human tagger's saved windows for a star into merged
# "regions" of agreement, reusing the same interval-merge machinery as the
# bandit selector above. Input: a named list where each name is a user_id
# and each value is that user's list of c(start, end) windows (e.g. the
# output of get_star_human_tag_sets()). A user who explicitly tagged "no
# transit" contributes an empty window list, so they add no region here,
# but the caller should still count them in the tagger-count denominator
# when reporting "N of M taggers agree" for a region - silence on a region
# is itself information, not a missing vote.
# Returns a data frame with one row per merged region: start, end,
# n_taggers (how many distinct users have a window overlapping it), and
# taggers (a comma-separated list of their names), sorted by start.
build_community_regions <- function(tagger_windows) {
  empty_out <- data.frame(start = integer(0), end = integer(0),
                           n_taggers = integer(0), taggers = character(0),
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  rows_list <- lapply(names(tagger_windows), function(tg) {
    ws <- tagger_windows[[tg]]
    if (length(ws) == 0) return(NULL)
    do.call(rbind, lapply(ws, function(w) data.frame(tagger = tg, start = w[1], end = w[2], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)))
  })
  rows <- do.call(rbind, rows_list)
  if (is.null(rows) || nrow(rows) == 0) return(empty_out)
  
  rows <- rows[order(rows$start), ]
  region_id <- integer(nrow(rows))
  region_id[1] <- 1
  cur_region <- 1
  cur_end <- rows$end[1]
  if (nrow(rows) > 1) {
    for (i in 2:nrow(rows)) {
      if (rows$start[i] <= cur_end + 1) {
        region_id[i] <- cur_region
        cur_end <- max(cur_end, rows$end[i])
      } else {
        cur_region <- cur_region + 1
        region_id[i] <- cur_region
        cur_end <- rows$end[i]
      }
    }
  }
  rows$region_id <- region_id
  
  agg <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(rows, rows$region_id), function(g) {
    data.frame(
      start = min(g$start), end = max(g$end),
      n_taggers = length(unique(g$tagger)),
      taggers = paste(sort(unique(g$tagger)), collapse = ", "),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
  agg <- agg[order(agg$start), ]
  rownames(agg) <- NULL
  agg
}

server = function(input, output, session) {
  
  # Unified SQLite connection for the session, closed on session end
  db_conn <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), sql_db_file)
  session$onSessionEnded(function() {
    if(DBI::dbIsValid(db_conn)) {
      DBI::dbDisconnect(db_conn)
    }
  })
  
  logout_init <- shinyauthr::logoutServer(
    id = "logout",
    active = reactive(credentials()$user_auth)
  )
  
  credentials <- shinyauthr::loginServer(
    id = "login", 
    data = user_base,
    user_col = user,
    pwd_col = password_hash,
    sodium_hashed = TRUE,
    log_out = reactive(logout_init())
  )
  
  observe({
    if(credentials()$user_auth) {
      shinyjs::removeClass(selector = "body", class = "sidebar-collapse")
    } else {
      shinyjs::addClass(selector = "body", class = "sidebar-collapse")
    }
  })
  
  output$kplr_id <- renderUI({
    if(credentials()$user_auth) {
      return(selectInput(inputId = "kplr_id", label = "Select Kepler ID:",
                         choices = options, selected = options[1]))
    }
  })
  
  # Live "does this star need more tagging?" readout for whichever star is
  # currently selected. Uses the posterior MEAN (not a fresh random draw)
  # so the badge doesn't visibly flicker on every re-render - only the
  # "Suggest Next Star" button below draws a fresh Thompson sample.
  output$star_priority_badge <- renderUI({
    req(credentials()$user_auth, input$kplr_id)
    tag_save_trigger()
    st <- compute_star_bandit_stats(db_conn, current_star_id())
    label <- switch(st$source,
      "cold-start"    = "Not tagged by anyone yet",
      "single-tagger" = "Tagged by 1 user so far",
      "human-model"   = sprintf("1 user \u2014 %.0f%% match with model detection", 100 * st$mean_agree),
      "human-human"   = sprintf("%d users \u2014 %.0f%% pairwise agreement", st$n_human, 100 * st$mean_agree))
    priority_mean <- st$alpha_disagree / (st$alpha_disagree + st$alpha_agree)
    tier <- if (priority_mean > 0.6) "High priority" else if (priority_mean > 0.35) "Medium priority" else "Low priority"
    color <- if (priority_mean > 0.6) "#dc2626" else if (priority_mean > 0.35) "#d97706" else "#16a34a"
    div(style = "font-size: 0.8em; color: #ccc;",
        span(style = paste0("display:inline-block; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:10px; background:",
                             color, "; color:white; font-weight:bold;"), tier),
        div(style = "margin-top:4px;", label)
    )
  })
  
  # Thompson-Sampling star recommendation: draws one fresh sample per star
  # from compute_star_bandit_stats() and jumps the dropdown to whichever
  # star that sample favors.
  observeEvent(input$bandit_suggest, {
    req(credentials()$user_auth)
    ranked <- rank_stars_by_bandit(db_conn, options)
    pick <- ranked[1, ]
    updateSelectInput(session, "kplr_id", selected = pick$star)
    msg <- if (pick$n_human == 0) {
      sprintf("Suggested %s \u2014 no one has tagged it yet.", pick$star)
    } else {
      sprintf("Suggested %s \u2014 tagged by %d user(s), ~%.0f%% agreement so far.",
              pick$star, pick$n_human, 100 * pick$mean_agree)
    }
    showNotification(msg, type = "message", duration = 6)
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$signup, {
    refresh <- F
    if(input$user == "") {
      output$error <- renderText(return('<font color = "red"><b>Username cannot be blank!<b></font>'))
    }
    if(input$password == "") {
      output$error <- renderText(return('<font color = "red"><b>Password cannot be blank!<b></font>'))
    }
    if(input$name == "") {
      output$error <- renderText(return('<font color = "red"><b>Name cannot be empty!<b></font>'))
    }
    if(input$name != "" & input$password != "" & input$user != "") {
      current_users <- dbGetQuery(db_conn, "SELECT * FROM user_base;")
      if(input$user %in% current_users$user) {
        output$error <- renderText(return('<font color = "red"><b>Username already exists. Please enter a differnet username!<b></font>'))
      } else {
        passwd_hsh <- sodium::password_store(input$password)
        insert_query <- paste0("INSERT INTO user_base VALUES('", input$user, "', '", passwd_hsh, "', '", input$permissions, "', '", input$name, "');")
        dbExecute(db_conn, insert_query)
        output$error <- renderText(return('<font color = "green"><b>Signup successful! Please refresh the page before attempting to login<b></font>'))
        refresh <- T
      }
    }
    user_base <<- dbGetQuery(db_conn, "SELECT * FROM user_base;")
    if(refresh) {
      shinyjs::refresh()
    }
  })
  
  # Helper to retrieve candidate indices from user_star or test_idx
  get_candidate_indices <- function(id, username) {
    query <- paste0("SELECT * FROM user_star WHERE user_id='", username,
                    "' AND kepler_id=", id, ";")
    query_result <- dbGetQuery(db_conn, query)
    if(nrow(query_result) == 0) {
      query <- paste0("SELECT * FROM test_idx WHERE id=", id, ";")
      query_result <- dbGetQuery(db_conn, query)
    }
    if(nrow(query_result) > 0) {
      return(list(starts = query_result$start, ends = query_result$end))
    }
    return(list(starts = 0, ends = 0))
  }
  
  # Helper: current star's numeric Kepler id, from the selected dropdown value
  current_star_id <- reactive({
    req(input$kplr_id)
    as.integer(gsub(strsplit(input$kplr_id, "_")[[1]][1],
                    pattern = "kplr", replacement = ""))
  })
  
  # Reactive state for zoom boundaries
  zoom_state <- reactiveValues(xlim = NULL)
  
  # The user's saved tag windows for the currently selected star (falls back
  # to model-detected candidates when the user has no saved tags of their own)
  saved_indices <- reactiveVal(list(starts = 0, ends = 0))
  
  refresh_saved_indices <- function() {
    req(input$kplr_id)
    saved_indices(get_candidate_indices(current_star_id(), user_info()$name))
  }
  
  # --- Manual tagging session state -----------------------------------
  # Separate from regular brush-to-zoom: while tag_mode is TRUE, drag-select
  # defines NEW candidate windows (fixed one at a time via "Fix Brush as
  # Window") instead of zooming, and previously fixed windows are drawn as
  # draggable/resizable shapes on the plot.
  tag_mode <- reactiveVal(FALSE)
  tag_windows <- reactiveVal(list())      # list of c(start, end) pairs
  tag_redraw_trigger <- reactiveVal(0)    # bumped only on STRUCTURAL changes
  # (new/removed window, session start/end) so that live edge-dragging - which
  # already updates instantly client-side in plotly - doesn't force a full
  # plot rebuild while the user is mid-drag.
  bump_tag_redraw <- function() tag_redraw_trigger(isolate(tag_redraw_trigger()) + 1)

  # Result of the most recent BLS (Box Least Squares) period search for the
  # currently selected star; NULL until "Verify Period (BLS)" is run, and
  # cleared whenever a different star is selected.
  bls_result <- reactiveVal(NULL)
  
  # Bumped whenever a tagging change is saved (confirm/reset) so the
  # star-priority badge recomputes; the bandit "Suggest" button always
  # recomputes live on click regardless of this trigger.
  tag_save_trigger <- reactiveVal(0)
  
  # NULL whenever the most recent trainPlot render used a real model
  # prediction; otherwise one of "no_model" / "no_keras" / "load_error",
  # set live inside output$trainPlot so output$model_fallback_banner can
  # warn that the plot is showing a flat zero baseline, not a real result.
  model_fallback_state <- reactiveVal(NULL)
  
  # Result of the fast, model-free triage_scan() (see util.R) for whichever
  # star output$trainPlot most recently rendered. NULL until a star has been
  # scored at least once.
  triage_state <- reactiveVal(NULL)
  
  # Whether the "Community Tags" panel is currently expanded. Toggled by
  # the toolbar button; independent of tag_mode so it can be checked
  # either while browsing or while actively tagging.
  community_tags_visible <- reactiveVal(FALSE)
  
  output$tag_window_summary <- renderText({
    w <- tag_windows()
    if (length(w) == 0) {
      "No windows fixed yet. Drag-select a range on the plot, then click 'Fix Brush as Window'."
    } else {
      paste0(length(w), " window(s) fixed: ",
             paste(sapply(w, function(x) paste0("[", x[1], "-", x[2], "]")), collapse = ", "))
    }
  })
  
  # Reset zoom/tagging state when a different star is selected
  observeEvent(input$kplr_id, {
    zoom_state$xlim <- NULL
    tag_mode(FALSE)
    tag_windows(list())
    bls_result(NULL)
    refresh_saved_indices()
  })
  
  # Zoom into current drag-selection (view mode only)
  observeEvent(input$zoom_brush, {
    req(!isTRUE(tag_mode()))
    sel <- event_data("plotly_selected", source = "trainPlot_src")
    if (!is.null(sel) && nrow(sel) > 0) {
      st <- floor(max(1, min(sel$x)))
      en <- ceiling(max(sel$x))
      if (en > st + 3) zoom_state$xlim <- c(st, en)
    }
  })
  
  # Enter tagging mode, pre-loaded with the star's currently saved tags
  observeEvent(input$start_tagging, {
    tag_windows(indices_to_windows(saved_indices()))
    tag_mode(TRUE)
    bump_tag_redraw()
  })
  
  # Enter tagging mode with a blank slate (replaces the old "Customize"
  # behavior of writing a (0,0) placeholder row directly to the database -
  # now nothing is written until the user explicitly confirms)
  observeEvent(input$customize, {
    tag_windows(list())
    tag_mode(TRUE)
    bump_tag_redraw()
  })
  
  # Fix the current drag-selection as a new tag window
  observeEvent(input$fix_brush, {
    req(isTRUE(tag_mode()))
    sel <- event_data("plotly_selected", source = "trainPlot_src")
    if (is.null(sel) || nrow(sel) == 0) {
      showNotification("Drag-select a range on the plot first, then click 'Fix Brush as Window'.", type = "warning")
      return(invisible(NULL))
    }
    st <- floor(max(1, min(sel$x)))
    en <- ceiling(max(sel$x))
    if (en <= st + 1) {
      showNotification("Selected range is too small.", type = "warning")
      return(invisible(NULL))
    }
    windows <- tag_windows()
    windows[[length(windows) + 1]] <- c(st, en)
    tag_windows(windows)
    bump_tag_redraw()
  })
  
  # Remove the most recently fixed window
  observeEvent(input$undo_window, {
    req(isTRUE(tag_mode()))
    windows <- tag_windows()
    if (length(windows) > 0) {
      windows[[length(windows)]] <- NULL
      tag_windows(windows)
      bump_tag_redraw()
    }
  })
  
  # Sync edge-drag / move edits on fixed window shapes back into tag_windows.
  # Deliberately does NOT call bump_tag_redraw(): plotly has already updated
  # the shape client-side as part of the drag, so we only need to keep the
  # server-side value in sync for when the session is confirmed or redrawn
  # for another reason (e.g. a subsequent zoom).
  observeEvent(event_data("plotly_relayout", source = "trainPlot_src"), {
    req(isTRUE(tag_mode()))
    ed <- event_data("plotly_relayout", source = "trainPlot_src")
    if (is.null(ed)) return(invisible(NULL))
    shape_keys <- grep("^shapes\\[[0-9]+\\]\\.(x0|x1)$", names(ed), value = TRUE)
    if (length(shape_keys) == 0) return(invisible(NULL))
    windows <- tag_windows()
    for (k in shape_keys) {
      m <- regmatches(k, regexec("^shapes\\[([0-9]+)\\]\\.(x0|x1)$", k))[[1]]
      i <- as.integer(m[2]) + 1L  # shapes[] is 0-indexed in plotly.js
      coord <- m[3]
      val <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(ed[[k]]))
      if (i >= 1 && i <= length(windows) && !is.na(val)) {
        if (coord == "x0") windows[[i]][1] <- floor(val) else windows[[i]][2] <- ceiling(val)
      }
    }
    windows <- lapply(windows, function(w) c(min(w), max(w)))
    tag_windows(windows)
  }, ignoreNULL = TRUE, ignoreInit = TRUE)
  
  # Save all fixed windows to the sqlite database as the user's tagged data
  observeEvent(input$confirm_tags, {
    req(isTRUE(tag_mode()))
    username <- user_info()$name
    id <- current_star_id()
    windows <- tag_windows()
    dbExecute(db_conn, "DELETE FROM user_star WHERE user_id = ? AND kepler_id = ?;",
              params = list(username, id))
    if (length(windows) == 0) {
      dbExecute(db_conn, "INSERT INTO user_star VALUES (?, ?, 0, 0);",
                params = list(username, id))
    } else {
      for (w in windows) {
        dbExecute(db_conn, "INSERT INTO user_star VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?);",
                  params = list(username, id, floor(w[1]), ceiling(w[2])))
      }
    }
    tag_mode(FALSE)
    tag_windows(list())
    refresh_saved_indices()
    tag_save_trigger(isolate(tag_save_trigger()) + 1)
    showNotification(paste0("Saved ", length(windows), " tagged window(s)."), type = "message")
  })
  
  # Discard the tagging session without touching the database
  observeEvent(input$cancel_tagging, {
    tag_mode(FALSE)
    tag_windows(list())
  })
  
  # Zoom in (+50%)
  observeEvent(input$zoom_in, {
    req(input$kplr_id)
    file <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = input$kplr_id, full.names = TRUE)[1]
    if(!is.na(file) && file.exists(file)) {
      raw_df <- read_kepler_table(file)
      cleaned_df <- clean_light_curve(raw_df)
      split_res <- split_train_test(cleaned_df, train_ratio = train_ratio, seq_len = seq_len)
      tot_len <- length(split_res$y_test)
      cur_lim <- if(is.null(zoom_state$xlim)) c(1, tot_len) else zoom_state$xlim
      mid <- (cur_lim[1] + cur_lim[2]) / 2
      half <- (cur_lim[2] - cur_lim[1]) / 4
      if(half >= 3) {
        zoom_state$xlim <- c(floor(max(1, mid - half)), ceiling(min(tot_len, mid + half)))
      }
    }
  })
  
  # Zoom out (-50%)
  observeEvent(input$zoom_out, {
    req(input$kplr_id)
    file <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = input$kplr_id, full.names = TRUE)[1]
    if(!is.na(file) && file.exists(file)) {
      raw_df <- read_kepler_table(file)
      cleaned_df <- clean_light_curve(raw_df)
      split_res <- split_train_test(cleaned_df, train_ratio = train_ratio, seq_len = seq_len)
      tot_len <- length(split_res$y_test)
      cur_lim <- if(is.null(zoom_state$xlim)) c(1, tot_len) else zoom_state$xlim
      mid <- (cur_lim[1] + cur_lim[2]) / 2
      half <- (cur_lim[2] - cur_lim[1])
      new_st <- max(1, floor(mid - half))
      new_en <- min(tot_len, ceiling(mid + half))
      if(new_st <= 1 && new_en >= tot_len) {
        zoom_state$xlim <- NULL
      } else {
        zoom_state$xlim <- c(new_st, new_en)
      }
    }
  })
  
  # Reset zoom to full light curve
  observeEvent(input$zoom_reset, {
    zoom_state$xlim <- NULL
  })
  
  # Run a BLS (Box Least Squares) period search on the full light curve for
  # the selected star, using whichever windows are currently "live" - the
  # in-progress tag_windows() while tagging, otherwise the star's saved (or
  # model-detected) windows - as a duration hint. Read-only: does not touch
  # user_star / test_idx, it only estimates period/duration/depth for
  # on-screen verification.
  observeEvent(input$verify_period, {
    req(input$kplr_id)
    file <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = input$kplr_id, full.names = TRUE)[1]
    if (is.na(file) || !file.exists(file)) return(invisible(NULL))
    
    windows <- if (isTRUE(tag_mode())) isolate(tag_windows()) else indices_to_windows(isolate(saved_indices()))
    
    result <- withProgress(message = "Running BLS period search...", value = 0.2, {
      raw_df <- read_kepler_table(file)
      cleaned_df <- clean_light_curve(raw_df)
      split_res <- split_train_test(cleaned_df, train_ratio = train_ratio, seq_len = seq_len)
      test_vec <- as.vector(split_res$y_test)
      incProgress(0.3, detail = "Scanning trial periods")
      out <- run_bls_search(flux = test_vec, windows = windows, cadence_days = cadence_days)
      incProgress(0.5, detail = "Done")
      out
    })
    
    if (is.null(result)) {
      showNotification("Not enough data (or no clear dip) to run a period search on this star.", type = "warning")
      bls_result(NULL)
    } else {
      bls_result(result)
    }
  })
  
  user_info <- reactive({
    return(credentials()$info)
  })
  
  output$welcome <- renderText({
    req(credentials()$user_auth)
    return(glue("Welcome {user_info()$name}"))
  })
  
  # Remove saved tags and revert to model-detected candidates (immediate,
  # does not go through a tagging session)
  observeEvent(input$reset, {
    dbExecute(db_conn, "DELETE FROM user_star WHERE user_id = ? AND kepler_id = ?;",
              params = list(user_info()$name, current_star_id()))
    tag_mode(FALSE)
    tag_windows(list())
    refresh_saved_indices()
    tag_save_trigger(isolate(tag_save_trigger()) + 1)
  })
  
  # Single reactive plot: reads input$kplr_id, zoom_state$xlim and tag_mode()
  # reactively (any of these force a full rebuild), but reads tag_windows()
  # via isolate() together with the lightweight tag_redraw_trigger() - so a
  # window shape being live-dragged does not itself force a rebuild, only
  # explicit structural changes (fix/undo/start/confirm/cancel) do.
  output$trainPlot <- renderPlotly({
    req(credentials()$user_auth, input$kplr_id)
    kplr_id_val <- input$kplr_id
    in_tag_mode <- isTRUE(tag_mode())
    tag_redraw_trigger()
    xlim_dep <- zoom_state$xlim
    
    file <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = kplr_id_val, full.names = TRUE)[1]
    if(is.na(file) || !file.exists(file)) return(NULL)
    
    out_base <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))
    dir.create(plots_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
    plot_file <- file.path(plots_dir, paste0(out_base, "_test_plot.png"))
    
    mdl_candidates <- c(
      file.path("trained_models", paste0(out_base, ".hdf5")),
      file.path("../trained_models", paste0(out_base, ".hdf5")),
      file.path("trained_models", "global_conv1d_autoencoder.hdf5"),
      file.path("../trained_models", "global_conv1d_autoencoder.hdf5")
    )
    
    # score_star() (in util.R) is the single shared implementation of
    # "read, clean, triage-scan, predict-or-fall-back, detect, cache" - used
    # identically here and by the standalone precompute_all_stars.R batch
    # script, so the two can never silently disagree on a star's result.
    # It has no Shiny dependency, so the fallback/triage state it returns is
    # pushed into the reactiveVals here rather than inside score_star itself.
    score <- score_star(
      tbl_file = file, trained_model_paths = mdl_candidates,
      db_conn = db_conn, plot_file = plot_file,
      seq_len = seq_len, train_ratio = train_ratio, cadence_days = cadence_days
    )
    y_test <- score$y_test
    y_pred <- score$y_pred
    test_vec <- score$test_vec
    model_fallback_state(score$fallback_reason)
    triage_state(score$triage)
    
    # Anomaly mask for VIEW mode: reflects the user's saved tags (falling
    # back to model-detected candidates when the user has none of their own)
    idx_mask <- rep(FALSE, length(test_vec))
    cur_saved <- isolate(saved_indices())
    if(length(cur_saved$starts) > 0 && any(cur_saved$starts > 0)) {
      for(j in seq_along(cur_saved$starts)) {
        st <- cur_saved$starts[j]
        en <- min(cur_saved$ends[j], length(test_vec))
        if(st > 0 && en >= st) idx_mask[st:en] <- TRUE
      }
    }
    
    # Determine xlim and dynamic ylim for active zoom
    xlim <- if(is.null(xlim_dep)) c(1, length(test_vec)) else xlim_dep
    sub_indices <- max(1, xlim[1]):min(length(test_vec), xlim[2])
    sub_flux <- test_vec[sub_indices]
    
    if(length(sub_flux) > 0 && any(is.finite(sub_flux))) {
      fl_min <- min(sub_flux, na.rm = TRUE)
      fl_max <- max(sub_flux, na.rm = TRUE)
      pad <- max(0.05 * (fl_max - fl_min), 0.001)
      ylim <- c(fl_min - pad, fl_max + pad)
    } else {
      ylim <- NULL
    }
    
    title_str <- paste("Kepler Light Curve -", out_base,
                       if(!is.null(xlim_dep)) sprintf("[Zoomed: %d - %d]", xlim[1], xlim[2]) else "",
                       if(in_tag_mode) " [Manual Tagging Mode]" else "")
    
    pred_vec <- as.vector(y_pred)
    cur_windows <- isolate(tag_windows())
    
    build_light_curve_plotly(test_vec = test_vec, pred_vec = pred_vec,
                              xlim = xlim, ylim = ylim, idx_mask = idx_mask,
                              title_str = title_str,
                              mode = if(in_tag_mode) "tag" else "view",
                              tag_windows_list = cur_windows)
  })
  
  output$planet_page <- renderUI({
    req(credentials()$user_auth)
    return(fluidPage(
      fluidRow(
        column(width = 12,
          uiOutput("model_fallback_banner")
        )
      ),
      fluidRow(
        column(width = 12,
          plotlyOutput("trainPlot", height = "520px")
        )
      ),
      br(),
      fluidRow(
        column(width = 12,
          uiOutput("toolbar")
        )
      ),
      fluidRow(
        column(width = 12,
          uiOutput("bls_panel")
        )
      ),
      fluidRow(
        column(width = 12,
          uiOutput("community_tags_panel")
        )
      )
    ))
  })

  # Visible warning banner for whenever the plot above is showing the
  # zero-baseline fallback instead of a real model prediction (no model
  # file on disk, Keras/reticulate unavailable, or the model failed to
  # load/run) - so it is never mistaken for a genuine result.
  output$model_fallback_banner <- renderUI({
    req(credentials()$user_auth)
    reason <- model_fallback_state()
    if (is.null(reason)) return(NULL)
    
    if (identical(reason, "triage_skip")) {
      # Not a degraded result - the fast pre-model triage scan found no
      # statistically plausible dip at all, so the (comparatively expensive)
      # model load/inference was skipped on purpose. Shown as neutral/
      # informational rather than a warning, distinct from the three
      # reasons below where the model genuinely couldn't be run.
      tr <- triage_state()
      n_pts <- if (!is.null(tr) && is.finite(tr$n_candidate_points)) tr$n_candidate_points else 0
      return(div(style = "background:#e7f1ff; border:1px solid #b6d4fe; color:#084298; border-radius:6px; padding:8px 14px; margin-bottom:12px; font-size:0.9em; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;",
        icon("bolt"),
        strong("Fast triage:"),
        sprintf("no plausible dip found (%d candidate point%s below threshold) \u2014 full model skipped to save compute.",
                n_pts, if (identical(n_pts, 1L)) "" else "s")
      ))
    }
    
    msg <- switch(reason,
      "no_model"   = "No trained model found for this star (star-specific or global fallback) \u2014 showing a flat zero baseline, not a real prediction.",
      "no_keras"   = "The Keras/reticulate backend is not available on this server \u2014 showing a flat zero baseline, not a real prediction.",
      "load_error" = "A trained model file exists for this star but failed to load or run \u2014 showing a flat zero baseline, not a real prediction.",
      "Showing a flat zero baseline, not a real model prediction.")
    div(style = "background:#fff3cd; border:1px solid #ffe69c; color:#664d03; border-radius:6px; padding:8px 14px; margin-bottom:12px; font-size:0.9em; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px;",
        icon("triangle-exclamation"),
        strong("Fallback baseline in use:"), msg
    )
  })
  
  # Toggled by the "View/Hide Community Tags" toolbar button. Aggregates
  # every human tagger's saved windows for the current star into merged
  # regions, each annotated with how many (and which) taggers agree on it
  # and whether the model's own test_idx detection also covers it - so a
  # single user is no longer limited to seeing just their own tags (or the
  # model default) in isolation.
  output$community_tags_panel <- renderUI({
    req(credentials()$user_auth, input$kplr_id)
    if (!isTRUE(community_tags_visible())) return(NULL)
    tag_save_trigger()
    
    id <- current_star_id()
    human_sets <- get_star_human_tag_sets(db_conn, id)
    model_set <- get_star_model_tag_set(db_conn, id)
    n_human <- length(human_sets)
    regions <- build_community_regions(human_sets)
    
    body <- if (nrow(regions) == 0) {
      tags$p(style = "color:#777; font-style:italic; margin: 6px 0 0 0;",
             if (n_human == 0) "No one has tagged this star yet \u2014 be the first!"
             else "Every tagger for this star marked \u201cno transit\u201d \u2014 no candidate windows to show.")
    } else {
      merged_model <- merge_windows(model_set)
      regions$model_match <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(regions)), function(i) {
        windows_intersection_length(list(c(regions$start[i], regions$end[i])), merged_model) > 0
      }, logical(1))
      regions <- regions[order(-regions$n_taggers, regions$start), ]
      
      tags$table(class = "table table-striped table-condensed", style = "width:100%; font-size:0.85em; margin-top:8px;",
        tags$thead(tags$tr(
          tags$th("Window (cadence)"), tags$th("Agreement"), tags$th("Tagged by"), tags$th("Matches model?")
        )),
        tags$tbody(
          lapply(seq_len(nrow(regions)), function(i) {
            r <- regions[i, ]
            tags$tr(
              tags$td(sprintf("%d \u2013 %d", r$start, r$end)),
              tags$td(sprintf("%d / %d", r$n_taggers, n_human)),
              tags$td(r$taggers),
              tags$td(if (r$model_match) icon("check", style = "color:#16a34a;") else icon("minus", style = "color:#999;"))
            )
          })
        )
      )
    }
    
    div(style = "border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px; margin-bottom: 15px; background-color: #fafafa;",
        tags$b("Community Tags"),
        tags$p(style = "margin: 6px 0 0 0; font-size: 0.85em; color: #777;",
               sprintf("%d user%s tagged this star so far.", n_human, if (n_human == 1) "" else "s")),
        body
    )
  })
  
  observeEvent(input$toggle_community_tags, {
    community_tags_visible(!isTRUE(community_tags_visible()))
  })
  
  output$toolbar <- renderUI({
    if (isTRUE(tag_mode())) {
      div(style = "display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 15px;",
        bsButton("fix_brush", label = " Fix Brush as Window", icon = icon("thumbtack"), style = "primary"),
        bsTooltip(id = "fix_brush", title = "Drag-select a range on the plot, then click here to fix it as a tagged window", placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),

        bsButton("undo_window", label = " Undo Last Window", icon = icon("history"), style = "info"),
        bsTooltip(id = "undo_window", title = "Remove the most recently fixed window", placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),

        span(style = "margin-left: 10px; border-left: 2px solid #ddd; height: 32px; margin-right: 10px;"),

        bsButton("zoom_in", label = " Zoom In (+)", icon = icon("plus"), style = "info"),
        bsButton("zoom_out", label = " Zoom Out (-)", icon = icon("minus"), style = "info"),
        bsButton("zoom_reset", label = " Reset Zoom", icon = icon("arrows-alt"), style = "default"),

        span(style = "margin-left: 10px; border-left: 2px solid #ddd; height: 32px; margin-right: 10px;"),

        bsButton("confirm_tags", label = " Confirm Tags", icon = icon("check"), style = "success"),
        bsTooltip(id = "confirm_tags", title = "Save all fixed windows to your tagged data", placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),

        bsButton("cancel_tagging", label = " Cancel", icon = icon("times"), style = "danger"),
        bsTooltip(id = "cancel_tagging", title = "Discard this tagging session without saving", placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),

        span(style = "margin-left: 10px; border-left: 2px solid #ddd; height: 32px; margin-right: 10px;"),

        bsButton("verify_period", label = " Verify Period (BLS)", icon = icon("wave-square"), style = "default"),
        bsTooltip(id = "verify_period", title = "Run a Box Least Squares search on the full light curve, using the fixed windows as a duration hint, to estimate period/duration/depth", placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),

        span(style = "margin-left: 10px; border-left: 2px solid #ddd; height: 32px; margin-right: 10px;"),

        bsButton("toggle_community_tags", label = if (isTRUE(community_tags_visible())) " Hide Community Tags" else " View Community Tags", icon = icon("users"), style = "default"),
        bsTooltip(id = "toggle_community_tags", title = "See how other users have tagged this star, aggregated by per-region agreement", placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),

        div(style = "width: 100%; margin-top: 6px; font-size: 0.9em; color: #555;",
            textOutput("tag_window_summary")
        ),
        div(style = "width: 100%; font-size: 0.85em; color: #888;",
            "Drag an edge of a fixed (orange) window to resize it, or drag its body to move it. Drag on empty space to select a new range."
        )
      )
    } else {
      div(style = "display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 15px;",
        bsButton("zoom_brush", label = " Zoom to Selection", icon = icon("search-plus"), style = "primary"),
        bsTooltip(id = "zoom_brush", title = "Zoom into the range highlighted with the drag-select", placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),

        bsButton("zoom_in", label = " Zoom In (+)", icon = icon("plus"), style = "info"),
        bsTooltip(id = "zoom_in", title = "Zoom in by 50%", placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),

        bsButton("zoom_out", label = " Zoom Out (-)", icon = icon("minus"), style = "info"),
        bsTooltip(id = "zoom_out", title = "Zoom out by 50%", placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),

        bsButton("zoom_reset", label = " Reset Zoom", icon = icon("arrows-alt"), style = "default"),
        bsTooltip(id = "zoom_reset", title = "Reset zoom to full light curve", placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),

        span(style = "margin-left: 15px; border-left: 2px solid #ddd; height: 32px; margin-right: 10px;"),

        bsButton("start_tagging", label = " Edit Tags", icon = icon("pencil-alt"), style = "warning"),
        bsTooltip(id = "start_tagging", title = "Start a manual tagging session pre-loaded with your saved tags", placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),

        bsButton("customize", label = " Start Blank", icon = icon("eraser"), style = "warning"),
        bsTooltip(id = "customize", title = "Start a manual tagging session with a blank slate", placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),

        bsButton("reset", label = "Reset Tags to Model", icon = icon("undo"), style = "danger"),
        bsTooltip(id = "reset", title = "Remove saved tags and revert to model-detected candidates", placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),

        span(style = "margin-left: 15px; border-left: 2px solid #ddd; height: 32px; margin-right: 10px;"),

        bsButton("verify_period", label = " Verify Period (BLS)", icon = icon("wave-square"), style = "default"),
        bsTooltip(id = "verify_period", title = "Run a Box Least Squares search on the full light curve, using the current tagged windows as a duration hint, to estimate period/duration/depth", placement = "top", trigger = "hover"),

        span(style = "margin-left: 15px; border-left: 2px solid #ddd; height: 32px; margin-right: 10px;"),

        bsButton("toggle_community_tags", label = if (isTRUE(community_tags_visible())) " Hide Community Tags" else " View Community Tags", icon = icon("users"), style = "default"),
        bsTooltip(id = "toggle_community_tags", title = "See how other users have tagged this star, aggregated by per-region agreement", placement = "top", trigger = "hover")
      )
    }
  })
  
  # Summary panel + phase-folded verification plot for the most recent BLS
  # period search on the selected star. Hidden (NULL) until a search has
  # been run for the current star (see observeEvent(input$verify_period)).
  output$bls_panel <- renderUI({
    res <- bls_result()
    if (is.null(res)) return(NULL)
    div(style = "border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 6px; padding: 12px; margin-bottom: 15px; background-color: #fafafa;",
      tags$b("BLS Period Verification"),
      tags$p(style = "margin: 6px 0 10px 0; font-size: 0.85em; color: #777;",
             "Heuristic Box Least Squares search over the full light curve \u2014 a quick sanity check, not a publication-grade period search."),
      fluidRow(
        column(width = 3, tags$b("Period:"), br(), sprintf("%.3f days", res$period_days)),
        column(width = 3, tags$b("Duration:"), br(), sprintf("%.3f days", res$duration_days)),
        column(width = 3, tags$b("Depth:"), br(),
               if (is.na(res$depth_pct)) sprintf("%.4f", res$depth) else sprintf("%.4f (%.2f%% of baseline)", res$depth, res$depth_pct)),
        column(width = 3, tags$b("Signal strength:"), br(), sprintf("%.2f", res$snr))
      ),
      plotlyOutput("phaseFoldPlot", height = "320px")
    )
  })
  
  output$phaseFoldPlot <- renderPlotly({
    res <- bls_result()
    req(res)
    build_phase_fold_plotly(res)
  })
  
  output$login_page <- renderUI({
    if(!credentials()$user_auth) {
      return(
        tabBox(tabPanel("Login", shinyauthr::loginUI(id = "login",
                                                     title = "Login to access exoplanet dashboard")),
               tabPanel("Signup", fluidPage(
                 fluidRow(
                   textInput(inputId = "user", label = "Username"),
                   textInput(inputId = "name", "Name"),
                   textInput(inputId = "password", label = "Password"),
                   selectInput(inputId = "permissions", label = "Permissions", choices = c("admin", "standard"), selected = "standard"),
                   actionButton(inputId = "signup", label = "Signup", icon = icon("user-plus")),
                   uiOutput("error")
                 )))))
    }
  })
})
